name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 孫悟空 (NEW SPEC Ver.)
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Son Goku (NEW SPEC Ver.)

description.ja: Figure-rise Standardは新次元(NEW SPEC)へ！可動域と造形美、ここに極まれり。『ドラゴンボールZ』より孫悟空(NEW SPEC Ver.)が登場！
description.en: Figure-rise Standard goes to a new dimension (NEW SPEC)! The range of motion and beauty of the figure are truly extraordinary. Son Goku (NEW SPEC Ver.) appears from “Dragon Ball Z”!

description.ja: マッスルビルドシステムがパワーアップ！「マッスルビルドシステムPLUS」を新たに搭載。
description.en: Muscle build system is powered up! Newly equipped with "Muscle Build System PLUS".

description.ja: 人体構造の徹底検証とプラモデルの可動技術の進化により「最高峰の可動域」を実現。
description.en: The "highest range of motion" has been achieved through thorough examination of the human body structure and advancements in the plastic model's movable technology.

description.ja: 筋肉の流れに沿ったプラモデルならではのパーツ分割によって「絶対的な造形美」も両立。
description.en: The parts are divided according to the flow of the muscles, which is unique to a plastic model, and the model achieves "absolute beauty".

description.ja: 組み立てやすさもアップし、自らの手で肉体をビルドアップする楽しさと醍醐味を存分に味わってもらうことをテーマに研究・開発を重ねたシステムである。
description.en: A system that has been researched and developed with the theme of improving the ease of assembly and allowing you to fully enjoy the fun and thrill of building up your body with your own hands.

description.ja: • 首・胸・腰・手首等の各部可動域が大幅アップ。Figure-rise Standard史上最高峰の可動域を実現。
description.en: • The range of motion of the neck, chest, waist, wrists, etc. has been greatly improved. Figure-rise Standard achieves the highest range of motion in history.

description.ja: • 表情パーツ5種、ハンドパーツが5種付属。最高峰の可動によるポージングと合わせて様々な劇中シーンを再現可能。
description.en: • 5 types of facial expression parts and 5 types of hand parts are included. Various scenes from the play can be reproduced with the highest level of articulation and posing.

description.ja: • 人体構造を徹底検証。筋肉の隆起から指先まで細部に宿るリアリティを追求。
description.en: • Thorough examination of human body structure. Pursuing the reality in every detail, from the bulges of the muscles to the tips of the fingers.

description.ja: • パーツ分割や成形色にこだわり、組み立てるだけで全身の色分けを再現。
description.en: • We are particular about parts division and molding color, and reproduce the color coding of the whole body just by assembling.

description.ja: • 道着や靴の表面、関節パーツのシワ造形まで密度あるディテールを表現。絶対的な造形美を実現。
description.en: • The surface of the gi and shoes, as well as the wrinkles on the joint parts, are expressed in dense detail. Achieving absolute beauty.

description.ja: • 「ドラゴンボール」の星の数でランナーの番号タグを表現。ランナーは番号タグごとに分割ができパーツの管理も簡単。「ドラゴンボール」を探しながら楽しく組み立てができる。
description.en: • Represent Runner's number tag with the number of stars in "Dragon Ball ". Runner can be divided by number tag, making it easy to manage parts. You can have fun assembling while searching for " Dragon Balls".

description.ja: • ボーナスシールで道着のマークが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a gi mark as a bonus Seal.

description.ja: • ディスプレイ用台座が付属。

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ（左右）×3種、（右手）×2種
accessories.en: Hand parts (left and right) x 3 types, (right hand) x 2 types
